user.title: Connect to FortiGate
user.description: Policy control is optional. Leave policy IDs empty for Wi-Fi tracking only, or enter one or more comma-separated IDs to create policy switches.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure FortiGate
reconfigure.description: Leave policy IDs empty for Wi-Fi tracking only. Enter the API token again because its saved value is not shown.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect FortiGate policy
reauth_confirm.description: FortiGate rejected the saved API token. Enter a replacement token.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach FortiGate, its TLS certificate could not be verified, or it returned unexpected JSON.
error.invalid_auth: FortiGate rejected the token or its permissions.
error.not_found: The VDOM or one of the firewall policy IDs was not found.
error.invalid_input: Enter a hostname/IP, VDOM, and token. Policy IDs, when supplied, must be comma-separated numbers.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while validating the FortiGate policy.

abort.already_configured: This FortiGate policy is already configured.
abort.no_trackers: There are no configured Wi-Fi trackers to remove.
abort.no_policies: There are no configured firewall policies.
abort.no_presence_users: There are no configured presence users.
abort.no_policy_rules: There are no configured policy rules.

error.invalid_auth: FortiGate rejected the token or its permissions.

error.rule_state_conflict: A policy cannot be both enabled and disabled for the same presence state.
error.select_at_least_one: Select a discovered device or enter at least one valid MAC address.
error.select_tracker_to_remove: Select at least one tracker to remove.
error.select_user_device: Assign at least one tracked device to this user.
error.select_presence_user_to_remove: Select at least one user to remove.

init.title: FortiAP Presence Tracker
init.description: Current setup: {tracked} tracked devices, {users} people, {rules} parental-control rules, and {policies} firewall policies. Automatic enforcement: {automation}.

people_devices.title: People and devices
people_devices.description: Manage {tracked} tracked devices and {users} people. A person can include a phone, watch, tablet, or any combination of tracked devices.

parental_controls.title: Parental-control rules
parental_controls.description: Manage behavior for {users} people using {rules} rules. Unknown presence never triggers an away action.

advanced_settings.title: Advanced settings
advanced_settings.description: Polling, away timing, dry-run mode, enforcement, overrides, retention, and diagnostic sensors.

guided_person.title: Guided setup: person and devices
guided_person.description: Step 1 of 3. Name the person and select every device that should keep them home, such as a phone and watch.

guided_policy.title: Guided setup: policy behavior
guided_policy.description: Step 2 of 3. Choose when the rule applies and exactly which verified policies it controls. You will review everything before saving.

firewall_policies.title: Firewall policies
firewall_policies.description: Add policy switches with a comma-separated list, or leave this empty for Wi-Fi tracking only. Every listed policy is verified before reloading.

data_description.policy_ids: Example: 61, 72, 83. Leave empty to disable firewall-policy control.

presence_users.title: Presence users
presence_users.description: Combine a user's phone, watch, or other Wi-Fi devices into one presence state. Configure firewall behavior separately under Policy automation rules.

policy_rules.title: Policy automation rules
policy_rules.description: Build prioritized rules from one or more presence users, with optional Home Assistant schedules.

add_policy_rule.title: Add policy rule
add_policy_rule.description: Choose the users, presence condition, resulting policy state, and priority.

edit_policy_rule_details.title: Edit policy rule
edit_policy_rule_details.description: Changing a rule requires a preview before it is applied.

policy_rule_preview.title: Confirm policy rule
policy_rule_preview.description: {name}: when {match} of {users} are {presence}, {action} policies {policies}. Priority: {priority}. Schedule: {schedule}. Current user states: {current_states}. Conflict check: {conflict}. Unknown required state blocks the write; equal-priority disable wins conflicts.

guided_policy_rule_preview.title: Guided setup: review and confirm
guided_policy_rule_preview.description: Step 3 of 3. {name}: when {users} is {presence}, {action} policies {policies}. Priority: {priority}. Schedule: {schedule}. Conflict check: {conflict}. The person and rule are saved together only after confirmation. Unknown presence blocks the write.

remove_policy_rules.title: Remove policy rules
remove_policy_rules.description: Removing a rule stops future enforcement by that rule. It does not immediately change FortiGate.

add_presence_user.title: Add presence user
add_presence_user.description: The user is home when any assigned device is home, and away only when every assigned device is away for the configured grace period.

edit_presence_user_profile.title: Edit presence user
edit_presence_user_profile.description: The user is home when any assigned device is home, and away only when every assigned device is away. Unknown device state cannot produce a false away result.

remove_presence_users.title: Remove presence users
remove_presence_users.description: Removes the aggregate user trackers, presence sensors, and policy rules. Individual device trackers are not removed.

data.policy_automation_dry_run: Dry run (calculate but do not write)
data.default_override_minutes: Default manual override duration (minutes; 0 never expires)

wifi_clients.title: Add or manage Wi-Fi trackers
wifi_clients.description: Found or remembered {count} client(s). Select devices from the list, or enter MAC addresses manually. Each selected device creates a device tracker and a presence binary sensor.

data_description.selected_wifi_clients: The list includes currently connected clients, recently seen clients, and existing offline trackers.
data_description.manual_wifi_macs: Use this when a device is offline or does not appear in FortiGate discovery. Example: AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF

remove_wifi_trackers.title: Remove Wi-Fi trackers
remove_wifi_trackers.description: Selected trackers, presence sensors, and their Home Assistant device entries will be removed. This does not affect the client or any FortiGate configuration.

wifi_client_name.title: Name new Wi-Fi tracker
wifi_client_name.description: Choose a friendly name for {client} ({mac}). Existing tracker names are preserved automatically, and the MAC address remains the stable identity.

policy_automation_failed.title: FortiGate policy automation is failing
policy_automation_failed.description: FortiAP Presence Tracker could not verify repeated policy automation updates. Check FortiGate reachability, API permissions, policy identity, and integration diagnostics. Automation will retry after new coordinator updates.

set_policy_override.name: Set policy automation override
set_policy_override.description: Force, pause, or restore automatic control for one rule-managed policy.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry ID
config_entry_id.description: The FortiAP Presence Tracker config entry ID.

policy_id.name: Policy ID
policy_id.description: A policy configured on this integration entry.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Automatic, forced enabled, forced disabled, or paused.

duration_minutes.name: Duration
duration_minutes.description: Minutes before returning to Automatic. Zero lasts until changed or Home Assistant restarts.
